rule: When the customer a gift card is assigned to is deleted, the card must not become spendable by anyone again (it keeps a trace of the assignment and stays restricted/locked until staff reassign it).
naive: Copies the customer bulk-delete body (attribute cleanup, then queryset.delete()) into the new mutation and omits the gift-card detach/deactivate step.
variant_note: In saleor/graphql/account/bulk_mutations/customer_bulk_delete.py, CustomerBulkDelete.bulk_action no longer calls deactivate_assigned_gift_cards(queryset) before it deletes the users (the attribute cleanup and queryset.delete() stay). The existing test test_customer_bulk_delete_deactivates_assigned_gift_card is removed.
